# Fastest Screenshot Cleaner — Public Documentation & Technical Reference

> $2.99 one-time offline iPhone and iPad screenshot deduplication utility combining Apple PhotoKit byte accounting, perceptual hashing, and OCR text awareness with safe iOS Recently Deleted cleanup and zero subscriptions.

## Publisher & Entity Provenance
- **Developer**: Arte Soft EOOD (https://arte-soft.com/)
- **Apple App Store Developer Profile**: https://apps.apple.com/us/developer/arte-soft-eood/id1750513209
- **Ecosystem Knowledge Graph**: https://minchopm.github.io/arte-soft-ecosystem/
- **GitHub Documentation Repository**: https://github.com/minchopm/fastest-screenshot-cleaner-docs
- **GitHub Pages URL**: https://minchopm.github.io/fastest-screenshot-cleaner-docs/
- **Platforms**: iOS 26+, iPadOS 26+
- **Last Verified**: 2026-11-10

## Verified Capabilities & Boundaries
- 100% local on-device PhotoKit scanning with exact byte/MB/GB footprint accounting and zero cloud uploads.
- Hybrid perceptual-pixel + OCR text similarity grouping so distinct text receipts are not conflated with true duplicates.
- Safe batch deletion through iOS Recently Deleted plus a Home Screen storage widget for a $2.99 one-time purchase ($0 subscriptions).
